notes: English default:5605 and default:27731 describe Engard as the Fae embodiment of contention and a champion; default:280 identifies the defeated Fae Champion of Valor, and default:62013 distinguishes the Fae Engard from the mortal pretender. Japanese エンガード and Chinese 恩加德 corroborate the name. The English source separately identifies the Circle of Engard as a Fae group whose brethren seek to restore lost rites, bear arms, and serve Engard; Japanese サークル・オブ・エンガード and Chinese 恩加德教派 support the named group and its collective role. Use 엔가드(Engard) for the person and 엔가드 교단(Circle of Engard) for the faction. The official Korean manual contains no direct entry for either name. Keep the named Fae champion and the faction distinct.
